<p class="uni-intro">An experimental campus near Silicon Valley whose AI course's Pacman projects became classics — both our projects 031 and 032 come from here.</p>

> 硅谷附近的实验性校区，其人工智能课程的 Pacman 项目已成经典——我们的项目 031 与 032 都来自这里。

## Why it matters <span class='zh-inline'>(为何重要)</span>

UCSC pairs an experimental, interdisciplinary spirit with serious systems work — Ceph and the Pacman assignments both live here.

> UCSC 把实验性的跨学科精神与扎实的系统工作结合——Ceph 与 Pacman 作业都诞生于此。

## Background <span class='zh-inline'>(背景)</span>

Founded in 1965 as an experimental public campus, its Information and Computer Science department formed in the late 1960s and the Baskin School of Engineering was named in 1997.

> 1965 年作为实验性公立校区创办，信息与计算机科学系在 1960 年代末成立，1997 年工程学院以 Baskin 命名。

## People <span class='zh-inline'>(人物)</span>

| Person | Connection to computing |
|:--|:--|
| Jay Kreps | co-founder of Confluent and contributor to Apache Kafka. Faculty include **David Haussler** (UCSC Genome Browser) and **Ira Pohl** (ACM Fellow) |

> **Sage Weil**（2007 计算机博士）— 创建 Ceph 分布式存储系统。**Jay Kreps** — Confluent 联合创始人、Apache Kafka 贡献者。教师包括 **David Haussler**（UCSC 基因组浏览器）与 **Ira Pohl**（ACM 会士）。

| Course | Title |
|:--|:--|

| CSE 101 | Data Structures and Algorithms |
| CSE 102 | Analysis of Algorithms |
| CSE 120 | Computer Architecture |
| CSE 130 | Principles of System Design |

> CSE 140 人工智能（p0/p1 即项目 031/032）· CSE 101 数据结构与算法 · CSE 102 算法分析 · CSE 120 计算机体系结构 · CSE 130 系统设计原理。

## In this book <span class='zh-inline'>(本书收录)</span>

- [031 · Pacman warmup (CSE 140 p0)](https://github.com/polarours/Coursework/tree/master/problems/031-ucsc-cse140-pacman-warmup)
- [032 · Pacman search (CSE 140 p1)](https://github.com/polarours/Coursework/tree/master/problems/032-ucsc-cse140-pacman-search)

**Both Pacman projects come straight from CSE 140: first build a shop argmin, then the full search stack — DFS, BFS, UCS, A* — on the same framework.**

> 两个 Pacman 项目都直接来自 CSE 140：先做商店取优，再在同一框架上完成 DFS、BFS、UCS、A* 全套搜索。
